text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saadoun Hammadi, parliamentary speaker, says reports by U.N. Special Commission on Iraq are full of lies and fabrications.
- FAO blames U.N. sanctions committee for delays in arrival of agricultural substances and machines under Iraq's oil deal with U.N.
- Israel deploys troops in Hebron to confront Palestinian anger.
- More supplies of cooking oil arrive in Iraq.
- Demonstration in Rome denounces sanctions on Iraq.
- Yemen voices support for Iraq stands vis-a-vis sanctions and Arab and international issues.
- Iraqi and Russian parliaments sign cooperation deal.
- Arab newspapers attack U.S. policy towards Iraq.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Commentary attacks presence of U.S. and allied troops in Turkey.
- Commentary tries to spell out reasons behind anti-Iraq stand by the United States.
- Article says Jerusalem will be the eternal capital for Arabs and not Zionists.
